# discord_roles (Data Source)

Lists the roles of a server, including `@everyone`, ordered by position and then ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_roles" "all" {
  server_id = var.server_id
}

output "managed_roles" {
  value = [for r in data.discord_roles.all.roles : r.name if r.managed]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) The roles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `color` (Number) Primary RGB color.
- `hoist` (Boolean) Whether members are displayed separately.
- `id` (String) Role ID. The `@everyone` role has the server's ID.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether the role is managed by an integration.
- `mentionable` (Boolean) Whether the role can be mentioned by anyone.
- `name` (String) Role name.
- `permissions` (String) Permission bitfield as a decimal string.
- `position` (Number) Role position.
